dialog.title: Restart {agent}?
dialog.subtitle: It was started before MoltenTerm's update, without its browser and hooks.
dialog.body: MoltenTerm types {agent}'s exit command, waits for it to exit, starts a fresh shell in the same folder and starts {agent} again on the same conversation, with MoltenTerm's integration.
dialog.note: Before that, Escape answers No to a question {agent} may be asking and an unsent draft in its input is cleared. Nothing is killed: if {agent} does not exit, it keeps running.

app:nativecontextmenu.label: System context menus
app:nativecontextmenu.description: Use the system's context menus instead of MoltenTerm's.

app:globalhotkey.label: Global shortcut
app:globalhotkey.description: A system-wide shortcut that brings MoltenTerm to the front.

app:defaultnewblock.label: New tab content
app:defaultnewblock.description: The view a new tab starts with, such as term.

app:showoverlayblocknums.label: Panel numbers
app:showoverlayblocknums.description: Show each panel's number while its shortcut keys are held.

app:ctrlvpaste.label: Ctrl+V pastes
app:ctrlvpaste.description: Ctrl+V pastes in terminals instead of reaching the program.

app:disablectrlshiftarrows.label: No Ctrl+Shift+arrow navigation
app:disablectrlshiftarrows.description: Ctrl+Shift+arrows reach the program instead of moving between panels.

app:disablectrlshiftdisplay.label: No panel numbers on Ctrl+Shift
app:disablectrlshiftdisplay.description: Holding Ctrl+Shift does not show the panels' numbers.

app:focusfollowscursor.label: Focus follows the pointer
app:focusfollowscursor.description: Focus the panel under the pointer without a click.

app:tilelauncher.label: Tile launcher in empty panes
app:tilelauncher.description: An empty pane shows the tile launcher instead of the command palette.

feature:waveappbuilder.label: App builder
feature:waveappbuilder.description: Show the Apps tool in the rail outside development builds.

term:fontfamily.label: Font
term:fontfamily.description: A monospace font installed on this computer, such as Hack.

term:theme.label: Theme
term:theme.description: The colours of every terminal without a theme of its own.

term:disablewebgl.label: No WebGL in terminals
term:disablewebgl.description: Draw terminals without WebGL, slower but safer on some GPUs.

term:localshellpath.label: Shell
term:localshellpath.description: The shell local terminals start, such as /bin/zsh; empty uses your login shell.

term:localshellopts.label: Shell arguments
term:localshellopts.description: The arguments passed to the local shell.

term:scrollback.label: Scrollback
term:scrollback.description: How many lines of output a terminal keeps.

term:transparency.label: Transparency
term:transparency.description: How much of the window's background shows through a terminal.

term:allowbracketedpaste.label: Bracketed paste
term:allowbracketedpaste.description: Programs can tell pasted text from typed text.

term:shiftenternewline.label: Shift+Enter inserts a line
term:shiftenternewline.description: Shift+Enter sends a new line instead of Enter.

term:macoptionismeta.label: Option is Meta
term:macoptionismeta.description: The Option key sends Meta to terminal programs instead of typing symbols.

term:cursor.label: Cursor
term:cursor.description: The shape of the terminal cursor.

term:bellsound.label: Bell sound
term:bellsound.description: Play a sound when a program rings the bell.

term:bellindicator.label: Bell indicator
term:bellindicator.description: Mark the tab when a program rings the bell.

term:osc52.label: Clipboard access
term:osc52.description: When programs in a terminal may write to the clipboard (OSC 52).

term:durable.label: Durable sessions
term:durable.description: New terminals keep running when MoltenTerm quits or updates.

term:showsplitbuttons.label: Split buttons in headers
term:showsplitbuttons.description: Show split buttons in terminal headers.

term:trimtrailingwhitespace.label: Trim copied lines
term:trimtrailingwhitespace.description: Copying drops the spaces at the end of each line.

agent:sessionroots.label: More session folders
agent:sessionroots.description: Extra configuration folders per agent whose sessions the companion reads.

agent:integrate.label: Agent integration
agent:integrate.description: claude and codex get MoltenTerm's hooks and browser for each run; your files are not edited.

agent:integrateoff.label: Without integration
agent:integrateoff.description: Agents started without the integration while the others keep it.

review:language.label: Review language
review:language.description: Language of the review briefing and answers (fr, French...); empty: the interface language.

app:language.label: Interface language
app:language.description: The language of menus, panels and dialogs. Applies at once.

companion:usagegauges.label: Plan usage
companion:usagegauges.description: The agents whose plan usage the companion shows.

companion:usageclaudeoauth.label: Claude Code limits (experimental)
companion:usageclaudeoauth.description: Read Claude Code's limits from Anthropic's undocumented endpoint with its own sign-in.

linemap:animation.label: Animate the line map
linemap:animation.description: Play the load sequence and the moving trains; reduced motion turns it off.

cicd:runs.label: Runs shown
cicd:runs.description: Which runs a CI/CD panel shows first.

editor:minimapenabled.label: Minimap
editor:minimapenabled.description: Show the code overview on the editor's right edge.

editor:stickyscrollenabled.label: Sticky scroll
editor:stickyscrollenabled.description: Keep the enclosing scopes at the top of the editor while scrolling.

editor:wordwrap.label: Wrap long lines
editor:wordwrap.description: The editor wraps lines wider than the panel.

editor:fontsize.label: Editor text size
editor:fontsize.description: The text size of file views and the editor.

editor:inlinediff.label: Inline diffs
editor:inlinediff.description: Show diffs in one column instead of side by side.

web:openlinksinternally.label: Open links in MoltenTerm
web:openlinksinternally.description: Links clicked in a terminal or a page open in a browser panel.

web:defaulturl.label: Home page
web:defaulturl.description: The page a new browser panel opens.

web:defaultsearch.label: Search engine
web:defaultsearch.description: The search URL, with {query} where the words go.

browser:installed.label: Installed browser
browser:installed.description: The Chromium browser pages are handed off to.

browser:default.label: Open web pages in
browser:default.description: Where links and web pages open by default.

browser:sites.label: Per-site browser
browser:sites.description: Sites that always open in MoltenTerm's browser or the installed one.

browser:agentsites.label: Agent site permissions
browser:agentsites.description: Sites agents may use or are blocked from in the browser panel.

markdown:fontsize.label: Markdown text size
markdown:fontsize.description: The body text size of rendered Markdown.

markdown:fixedfontsize.label: Markdown code size
markdown:fixedfontsize.description: The text size of code in rendered Markdown.

preview:defaultsort.label: Sort files by
preview:defaultsort.description: The order of a file view's list.

tab:preset.label: Tab preset
tab:preset.description: The preset new tabs start from.

tab:background.label: Tab background
tab:background.description: The background new tabs get, from backgrounds.json.

tab:holdtoclose.label: Hold to close a tab
tab:holdtoclose.description: A tab's close button closes it after a press-and-hold, not a single click.

tab:holdtoclosems.label: Hold duration
tab:holdtoclosems.description: How long the close button is held before the tab closes.

power:sleeppolicy.label: Keep the computer awake
power:sleeppolicy.description: Whether terminals may keep the computer awake (caffeinate, systemd-inhibit).

moltenterm:tabviewpriority.label: Load tabs at full priority
moltenterm:tabviewpriority.description: Workspaces being opened load at the priority of the one on screen, so a busy machine cannot starve them.

moltenterm:tabviewbudget.label: Limit hidden workspaces
moltenterm:tabviewbudget.description: Workspaces not on screen are hidden and only the most recent stay loaded; others reload when shown.

moltenterm:hiddentabviews.label: Hidden workspaces kept loaded
moltenterm:hiddentabviews.description: How many workspaces not on screen stay loaded, so that coming back to them is instant.

moltenterm:hiddentabviewsmb.label: Memory for hidden workspaces
moltenterm:hiddentabviewsmb.description: Past this, the least recently used hidden workspace is unloaded.

moltenterm:tabviewhost.label: Open tabs when ready
moltenterm:tabviewhost.description: A new tab replaces the one on screen once it has rendered, with a pending state if it is slow.

moltenterm:hiddenpagefreeze.label: Pause hidden pages
moltenterm:hiddenpagefreeze.description: A page not on screen stops running until shown, unless an agent drives it or it plays audio.

moltenterm:hiddenpagediscardmin.label: Unload hidden pages after
moltenterm:hiddenpagediscardmin.description: A page not on screen this long is unloaded, then reloads when shown; 0 keeps pages loaded.

moltenterm:releasenotify.label: Tell me about new releases
moltenterm:releasenotify.description: Once a day at most, ask GitHub for a newer release and show its notes with a download link.

moltenterm:confirmbusyclose.label: Ask before stopping what runs
moltenterm:confirmbusyclose.description: Closing a pane or a tab in which an agent or a command runs asks first and names what would stop.

window:transparent.label: Transparent window
window:transparent.description: Let the desktop show through the window's background.

window:blur.label: Blur behind the window
window:blur.description: Blur the desktop behind a transparent window.

window:opacity.label: Window opacity
window:opacity.description: How opaque a transparent or blurred window is.

window:bgcolor.label: Window background
window:bgcolor.description: A CSS colour behind the panels, such as #1f1f1f.

window:reducedmotion.label: Reduce motion
window:reducedmotion.description: Turn off animations, as the system's reduced motion setting does.

window:tilegapsize.label: Gap between panels
window:tilegapsize.description: The space between the panels of a tab.

window:showmenubar.label: Menu bar
window:showmenubar.description: Show the menu bar in the window.

window:disablehardwareacceleration.label: No hardware acceleration
window:disablehardwareacceleration.description: Draw without the GPU; takes effect at the next launch.

window:maxtabcachesize.label: Tabs kept in memory
window:maxtabcachesize.description: How many tabs stay loaded in the background.

window:magnifiedblockopacity.label: Backdrop opacity
window:magnifiedblockopacity.description: How much the panels behind a magnified panel fade.

window:magnifiedblocksize.label: Magnified size
window:magnifiedblocksize.description: How much of the tab a magnified panel covers.

window:magnifiedblockblurprimarypx.label: Magnified backdrop blur
window:magnifiedblockblurprimarypx.description: The blur behind a magnified panel.

window:magnifiedblockblursecondarypx.label: Secondary backdrop blur
window:magnifiedblockblursecondarypx.description: The blur behind the other layers of a magnified panel.

window:confirmclose.label: Confirm before closing a window
window:confirmclose.description: Ask before closing a window that holds several tabs.

window:savelastwindow.label: Reopen the last window
window:savelastwindow.description: Closing the last window keeps it, so it opens again at the next launch.

window:dimensions.label: New window size
window:dimensions.description: The size of new windows, such as 1400x900.

window:zoom.label: Zoom
window:zoom.description: The zoom of the window's content; ⌘+ and ⌘- change it.

conn:askbeforewshinstall.label: Ask before installing it
conn:askbeforewshinstall.description: Ask before installing the helper on a new host.

conn:wshenabled.label: Shell integration on remotes
conn:wshenabled.description: Install MoltenTerm's helper on SSH hosts, for file views and folder tracking.

conn:localhostdisplayname.label: Name of this computer
conn:localhostdisplayname.description: How the local connection is named in headers and menus.

debug:pprofport.label: Profiler port
debug:pprofport.description: Serve Go's pprof on this port.

debug:webglstatus.label: WebGL status
debug:webglstatus.description: Show whether each terminal draws with WebGL.

tsunami:scaffoldpath.label: Scaffold path
tsunami:scaffoldpath.description: Where the app builder's scaffold lives.

tsunami:sdkreplacepath.label: SDK replace path
tsunami:sdkreplacepath.description: A local SDK used in place of the published one.

tsunami:sdkversion.label: SDK version
tsunami:sdkversion.description: The SDK version apps build against.

tsunami:gopath.label: Go binary
tsunami:gopath.description: The Go binary apps build with.

molten:folder.description: Where this workspace's new terminals and file views start.

molten:project.label: Project folder
molten:project.description: The project this workspace is linked to, for Mission Control.
